subject: general
question:
The given bar graph given below provides information about the quantity of salt produced by a company in 8 consecutive years. Study the information provided in the bar graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40c38d6584ee5414214804eec8f75dd6ee5880fdb7c04d936ff220b69b726583.png] 

The average production of salt in 2001 and 2003 was exactly equal to the average production of salt in which of the following pairs of years?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40c38d6584ee5414214804eec8f75dd6ee5880fdb7c04d936ff220b69b726583.png] 

**Calculation:**

Production of salt in 2001 and 2003 = 40 + 70 = 110000 tonnes

Production of salt in 2006 and 2007 = 50 + 80 = 130000 tonnes

Production of salt in 2001 and 2005 = 40 + 55 = 95000 tonnes

Production of salt in 2002 and 2007 = 30 + 80 = 110000 tonnes

Production of salt in 2005 and 2006 = 55 + 50 = 105000 tonnes

**Therefore, the average production of salt in 2001 and 2003 is exactly equal to the average production of salt in 2002 and 2007.**
